full_judgment: 26. Further, where any document purporting or proved to be 30 years old is produced from the proper custody, section 90 of the Evidence Act entitles the court to presume that it is a genuine document. The deed itself is more than 30 years old is an ancient document. A 30 years old document when produced from proper custody presumption under section 90 of the Evidence Act as to its validity can be raised. Learned Joint District Judge utterly failed to consider the CS record as well as this ancient document and came to a wrong finding that the plaintiff's predecessors-in-interest do not have any right and interest in the suit land.
